issues.problem: Unit error: fiscal 2021 R&D expense was about $3.9 billion ($3,924M), not $3.9 million.

data.summary: The analysis is accurate apart from one unit error. Revenue, gross profit and margin, operating income and margin, net income growth and EPS all match NVIDIA's reported FY2022 results, but FY2021 R&D was $3.9 billion, not $3.9 million.
